title: 中国晨间Bloomberg新闻摘要
summary: 今日重点关注的五则重要新闻。

sources.title: Rühl: US Almost Out of Options to Keep Oil Price Low
sources.description: Attacks on oil and gas infrastructure in the Arabian Gulf have escalated in the past two days. After a rebuke from President Trump, Israel says it will no longer target energy assets after its attack on an Iranian gas field sparked retaliatory strikes, cause oil and gas prices to surge. Crystol Energy Global Advisor, Christof Rühl, says the US is running out of methods to keep the oil price low if the Strait of Hormuz isn't reopened. He spokes to Joumanna Bercetche on Horizons Middle East and Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: European Gas Falls as US, Israel Seek to Ease Iran War Concerns
sources.description: European natural gas fell after Israel and the US sought to ease concerns about further attacks on Persian Gulf energy facilities.

sources.title: Asia Turns to Coal as Iran War Rapidly Shrinks Supplies of Gas
sources.description: War in the Middle East is forcing Asia to turn to coal to plug the gaping hole emerging in its supply of liquefied natural gas.

sources.title: VinFast Risks North Carolina Clawback of US EV Plant Incentives
sources.description: Pressure is mounting on VinFast Auto Ltd. after two US officials reminded the Vietnamese EV maker of its obligations under a four-year-old deal to build a mammoth plant in North Carolina.

sources.title: Dangote Demand Soars As War Disrupts Africa Fuel Supply
sources.description: African nations are scrambling to secure fuel from Nigeria's Dangote Refinery as war in the Middle East disrupts supply. The refinery is now seeing a massive surge in demand from countries like South Africa and Kenya to prevent local energy shortages. Bloomberg's Jennifer Zabasajja reports on Horizons Middle East and Africa. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: Unilever Confirms Talks on McCormick Offer for Food Business
sources.description: Unilever Plc said it’s in discussions to sell its food business to McCormick & Co. in a major shift for the maker of Hellmann’s mayonnaise.

sources.title: Where Billionaire Raamdeo Agrawal Is Finding Value in India
sources.description: Indian equities have slumped as the ongoing war in Iran drives energy prices sharply higher. Billionaire investor Raamdeo Agrawal, Chairman and Co‑Founder of Motilal Oswal Financial Services, examines where value is emerging. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: UK Posts Bigger-Than-Forecast £14.3 Billion Budget Deficit
sources.description: Britain borrowed more than forecast in February, showing the risks facing the public finances even before the war in Iran upended the economic outlook.

digest.episode_summary: 今日重点关注的五则重要新闻。
digest.lead: 今天，国际能源市场面临多重挑战。

stories.headline: Rühl: 美国几乎用尽了保持油价低的方法
stories.summary: 由于以色列在波斯湾对伊朗天然气设施发动攻击后引发报复性打击，导致石油和天然气价格飙升，美国能源专家Christof Rühl表示，如果霍尔木兹海峡不重新开放，美国将几乎没有方法维持油价的低位。
stories.why_it_matters: Rühl 的观点强调了当前国际局势下能源供应的脆弱性和不确定性。

stories.headline: 欧洲天然气价格下跌，美、以色列寻求缓解伊朗战争担忧
stories.summary: 由于美国和以色列试图缓解对波斯湾能源设施可能再次受到攻击的担忧，欧洲天然气价格出现下滑。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了国际社会对于中东局势变化的关注以及其对全球能源市场的影响。

stories.headline: 亚洲转向煤炭以应对伊朗战争迅速缩小的天然气供应
stories.summary: 由于波斯湾地区战争导致液化天然气供应急剧减少，亚洲国家正在转向煤炭来填补这一缺口。
stories.why_it_matters: 这突显了能源供应多样化的重要性以及在危机时刻各国采取的应对措施。

stories.headline: VinFast面临北卡罗来纳州激励计划回扣的压力
stories.summary: 由于美国两名官员提醒越南电动汽车制造商VinFast关于其与北卡罗来纳州签订的四年协议中的义务，该公司正承受压力。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了跨国公司遵守当地法规和政策的重要性以及潜在法律风险。

stories.headline: Dangote炼油厂需求激增，因中东战争扰乱了非洲燃料供应
stories.summary: 由于波斯湾地区的战争导致燃料供应中断，非洲国家正努力从尼日利亚的Dangote炼油厂获取燃料以避免国内能源短缺。
stories.why_it_matters: 这突显了全球供应链在危机中的脆弱性以及各国之间的合作需求。

stories.headline: Unilever考虑出售其食品业务给McCormick
stories.summary: Unilever表示正在与McCormick & Co.讨论出售其食品业务，这是该公司自Hellmann’s mayonnaise以来的重大转变。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了企业战略调整以及在特定行业中的竞争态势。
